rationale: The interview survey documents an oral whole sweet-orange practice intended to ease constipation. It reports no patient trajectory, separate denominator or Parkinson comparison.
The interview table identifies juice as the exposure in a separate field survey. The use value is a citation measure and supplies no constipation effect estimate.
Two participants describe improvement with combined approaches that include medication or other foods, while a third reports no benefit after oranges. The exposures and changes are not isolated.
